topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh, you had no idea, did you? Everyone was so pumped, all the plans we made, the cake, the balloons... It was gonna be epic. I was just talking to Alex, and they said everything’s off. I dunno what happened, one minute we’re all set, next, it’s like the party got lost. Maybe it’s for the best, I guess, but it doesn’t feel that way. I really wanted this for you, to see the look on your face, to have a night with no worries. We’ll figure something else out, okay? We can’t let this one little glitch ruin the fun we’re gonna have. Promise me you won’t let it, alright?
